reason: The in-browser x86_64 demo boots a prebuilt bootable snapshot (boot/DEPLOYED_TAG). Rebuilding that wasm demo image to a newer release is a separate build step, not part of the roadmap reconcile — so the demo honestly continues to boot V0.5-5 while the product is at V0.5-6.
tracking: Refresh the demo snapshot to the current release as part of the browser-demo build lane.
